pr.body:
## Summary
Hardens the deployed Genesis demo for the disclosed one-founder operating model. It narrows the claimed readiness scope to Security and Availability, removes required LLM spend, adds Firebase token and subject authorization, tests deny-by-default Firestore rules in the emulator, deploys an immutable image digest, and corrects the system/control descriptions to actual behavior (#54).

## Tickets
| Ticket | Title | Status |
|---|---|---|
| #54 | Harden the one-person SOC 2 readiness demo | In Review |
